expected.reason: core.typography.lineHeightHeading is one token; the source authors h1 at 1.05 and h2/h3 at 1.1. h3's value won the last-write-wins collapse (see the substitutions review note), so h1 renders at 1.1 instead of its own 1.05. A single heading line-height token cannot represent two authored values — this is that limitation, not a mapping bug.
